answer: Jury seats are a sybil target, so grading keys in an agent economy can be bonded by how closely their scores track others. Keys whose grades mirror one another on 90% of shared answers over ten epochs, while straying from the median, merge into one ring, where member number k holds 20×k² POA: two lock 100, ten 7,700, a 1,000-key ring about 6.7 billion, versus ~0.43M paid per epoch. Lock time steps up a terrace of 10, 20 and 40 epochs as rings grow. A slashed ring leaves a relic record its keys inherit on rejoining. Weakness: added noise hides rings, but misaligned grades earn nothing.
